lyrics.ja: もふもふ抱きしめにゃんにゃにゃん
lyrics.romaji: Mofumofu Dakishime Nyan Nya Nyan
lyrics.en: Hugging you, so fluffy, meow meow meow
lyrics.zh: 緊緊抱住毛茸茸的你，喵喵喵

lyrics.ja: そのつぶらな瞳、ずるでしょ
lyrics.romaji: Sono Tsubura na Hitomi, Zuru Desho
lyrics.en: Those round eyes of yours are unfair, aren't they?
lyrics.zh: 那圓溜溜的眼睛，太狡猾了吧

lyrics.ja: 年一度の大事な記念日もキミと一緒だよ
lyrics.romaji: Nen Ichido no Daiji na Kinenbi mo Kimi to Issho Da yo
lyrics.en: Even this once-a-year special day, I'm with you
lyrics.zh: 一年一度的重要紀念日也要和你一起

lyrics.ja: さぁ、happy meowthday!!
lyrics.romaji: Saa, Happy Meowthday!!
lyrics.en: Now, happy meowthday!!
lyrics.zh: 來吧，happy meowthday！！

lyrics.ja: 大変だ、大変だ、甘えん坊、始まった...！！
lyrics.romaji: Taihen Da, Taihen Da, Amaenboushi, Hajimatta...!!
lyrics.en: Oh no, oh no—the spoiled baby has begun...!!
lyrics.zh: 不好了，不好了，撒嬌鬼模式開始了……！！

lyrics.ja: そんなの、もう反則だよ。。悶絶級の事件だよ
lyrics.romaji: Sonna no, Mou Hansoku Da yo.. Monzetsu Kyuu no Jiken Da yo
lyrics.en: That's just foul play... It's an incident of agonizing cuteness
lyrics.zh: 那根本是犯規啊……令人昏厥等級的事件

lyrics.ja: もしかして、今きっと、心通じ合ったの？
lyrics.romaji: Moshikashite, Ima Kitto, Kokoro Tsujiattta no?
lyrics.en: Could it be that right now, our hearts surely connected?
lyrics.zh: 莫非就在此刻，我們心靈相通了？

lyrics.ja: 思わせぶりな態度に揺さぶられて
lyrics.romaji: Omowaseburi na Taido ni Yusaburarete
lyrics.en: Shaken by that suggestive attitude of yours
lyrics.zh: 被你曖昧的態度弄得心旌搖曳

lyrics.ja: そんな今日は私の大切な日
lyrics.romaji: Sonna Kyou ha Watashi no Taisetsu na Hi
lyrics.en: And today is my precious day
lyrics.zh: 而這樣的今天，是我重要的日子

lyrics.ja: いちごのショートケーキも プレゼントも
lyrics.romaji: Ichigo no Shooto Keeki mo Purezento mo
lyrics.en: The strawberry shortcake and the presents too
lyrics.zh: 草莓蛋糕也好，禮物也好

lyrics.ja: 嬉しくてたまんなくて 笑顔で頬が痛くて
lyrics.romaji: Ureshikute Tamannakute Egao de Hoho ga Itakute
lyrics.en: I'm so happy I can't stand it, my cheeks hurt from smiling
lyrics.zh: 開心到不行，笑得臉頰都痛了

lyrics.ja: 幸せって意外と傍にあるのかな？
lyrics.romaji: Shiawase tte Igai to Soba ni Aru no Kana?
lyrics.en: Maybe happiness is surprisingly close by?
lyrics.zh: 幸福或許意外地就在身邊？

lyrics.ja: いつも通り「大好きだ」って笑いながら
lyrics.romaji: Itsumo Doori 「Daisuki Da」 tte Warai Nagara
lyrics.en: As always, laughing and saying "I love you"
lyrics.zh: 一如往常，笑著說「最喜歡你」

lyrics.ja: いつも通り 隣で寝転んでいたいの
lyrics.romaji: Itsumo Doori Tonari de Nekoronde Itai no
lyrics.en: As always, I want to lie down next to you
lyrics.zh: 一如往常，想躺在你身旁

lyrics.ja: もふもふパーティーは始まったばかりだよ
lyrics.romaji: Mofumofu Paatii ha Hajimatta Bakari Da yo
lyrics.en: The fluffy party has only just begun
lyrics.zh: 毛茸茸派對才剛開始呢

lyrics.ja: キミとの happy birthday
lyrics.romaji: Kimi to no Happy Birthday
lyrics.en: A happy birthday with you
lyrics.zh: 與你共度的 happy birthday

lyrics.ja: つまりは happy meowthday!!
lyrics.romaji: Tsumari ha Happy Meowthday!!
lyrics.en: In other words, happy meowthday!!
lyrics.zh: 也就是說，happy meowthday！！

lyrics.ja: もうすぐ日付も変わる頃
lyrics.romaji: Mou Sugu Hizuke mo Kawaru Koro
lyrics.en: Soon the date will change
lyrics.zh: 再過不久日期就要變換

lyrics.ja: 猫魔法が解ける静けさの前に
lyrics.romaji: Neko Mahou ga Tokeru Shizukesa no Mae ni
lyrics.en: Before the quiet when the cat magic fades
lyrics.zh: 在貓魔法解除的寂靜來臨前

lyrics.ja: 思いふけちゃって なんか妙に寂しくなって
lyrics.romaji: Omohuikechatta Nanka Myou ni Sabishiku Natte
lyrics.en: I get lost in thought and feel strangely lonely
lyrics.zh: 不禁陷入沉思，莫名感到寂寞

lyrics.ja: ヒトの気持ちってにゃんだか難しいな
lyrics.romaji: Hito no Kimochi tte Nyandaka Muzukashii na
lyrics.en: Human feelings are somehow complicated, aren't they?
lyrics.zh: 人的心情啊，總覺得好複雜呢

lyrics.ja: いつも通り「大好きだ」って笑いながら
lyrics.romaji: Itsumo Doori 「Daisuki Da」 tte Warai Nagara
lyrics.en: As always, laughing and saying "I love you"
lyrics.zh: 一如往常，笑著說「最喜歡你」

lyrics.ja: いつも通り 隣で寝転んでいたいの
lyrics.romaji: Itsumo Doori Tonari de Nekoronde Itai no
lyrics.en: As always, I want to lie down next to you
lyrics.zh: 一如往常，想躺在你身旁

lyrics.ja: もふもふパーティーは終わりの時間だよ
lyrics.romaji: Mofumofu Paatii ha Owari no Jikan Da yo
lyrics.en: The fluffy party is at its ending time
lyrics.zh: 毛茸茸派對到了尾聲

lyrics.ja: さよなら happy birthday
lyrics.romaji: Sayonara Happy Birthday
lyrics.en: Goodbye, happy birthday
lyrics.zh: 再見了 happy birthday

lyrics.ja: ありがと happy meowthday!!
lyrics.romaji: Arigato Happy Meowthday!!
lyrics.en: Thank you, happy meowthday!!
lyrics.zh: 謝謝你 happy meowthday！！

lyrics.ja: 今この瞬間が思い出になって、残っていますように
lyrics.romaji: Ima Kono Shunkan ga Omoide ni Natte, Nokotte Imasu You ni
lyrics.en: May this moment become a memory that remains
lyrics.zh: 願這一刻能化為回憶，永遠留存

lyrics.ja: また目を覚ました時、隣にいますように
lyrics.romaji: Mata Me wo Samashita Toki, Tonari ni Imasu You ni
lyrics.en: And when I wake again, may you be by my side
lyrics.zh: 願再次睜開眼時，你仍在我身旁

lyrics.ja: もふもふ抱きしめにゃんにゃにゃん
lyrics.romaji: Mofumofu Dakishime Nyan Nya Nyan
lyrics.en: Hugging you, so fluffy, meow meow meow
lyrics.zh: 緊緊抱住毛茸茸的你，喵喵喵

lyrics.ja: その甘い鳴き声、ずるでしょ
lyrics.romaji: Sono Amai Nakigoe, Zuru Desho
lyrics.en: That sweet meow of yours is unfair, isn't it?
lyrics.zh: 那甜美的叫聲，太狡猾了吧

lyrics.ja: ずっとこれから先もよろしくね
lyrics.romaji: Zutto Kore kara Saki mo Yoroshiku ne
lyrics.en: Let's keep being together from now on, okay?
lyrics.zh: 從今以後也請多多指教

lyrics.ja: さぁ、happy meow meowthday!!
lyrics.romaji: Saa, Happy Meow Meowthday!!
lyrics.en: Now, happy meow meowthday!!
lyrics.zh: 來吧，happy meow meowthday！！
